critical: hold reason and next valid entry
RULE LEARNED gate name and text after rejection
CASE CHAIN link fill state reflecting committed facts
current: CONTRIBUTION clause showing facts added and stage progression after commit
hidden: sealed secret payloads (only test IDs exposed during validation)

navigation.device_switch: Pointer release or recapture preserves the current lead and dialogue state.
navigation.modal_behavior: Tutorial and dialogue lock world input, keep visible focus, and restore gameplay control on safe close.
navigation.destructive_behavior: No UI action deletes progress; corrupt load is rejected while current state remains visible.

layout.safe_area: Critical text and actions stay within the viewport while decorative key art may crop.
anchors: compact case status remains in the safe top-left region
interaction prompt remains centered above the ledger
ledger and action columns own the bottom region on wide displays and stack on narrow displays
layout.text_scaling: English copy uses wrapping containers, shorter labels, and 44 px minimum choice targets; no critical label relies on truncation.
layout.reflow: Below the existing narrow threshold, portrait art is selected and ledger/action columns stack without changing information order.
layout.scrolling: The ledger and dialogue choice collection retain explicit independent scroll ownership.

localization.externalized: This task intentionally ships one English runtime copy set in the existing Godot UI and narrative owners; multi-locale extraction is out of scope and is not claimed.
localization.expansion: Labels and buttons wrap; critical outcome words stay short and untruncated.
localization.bidirectional: Not in the declared English-only locale scope.
localization.fonts: The bundled OFL font covers English text; runtime status and icon redundancy use ASCII bracket markers only.
localization.input_glyphs: Prompts include readable physical-key labels such as E, Esc, F5, F9, M, V, and T.

signals: commit and hold use text, icon, line pattern, and color
the current lead remains written even when the objective beacon is off-screen
focus is visible on every start, tutorial, and dialogue action
audio and pointer state are persistent text labels
accessibility.settings_entry: Reduced motion, audio, and tutorial controls are visible before or during play.
accessibility.motion: Reduced motion removes camera bob and decorative transition motion while preserving stable verdict text and necessary locomotion state.
accessibility.media_alternatives: No decision depends on sound or animation alone.

data_bindings.source: committed canonical state plus the presentation-only first-meeting flag
data_bindings.initial_state: Direct the player to Captain Mira.
data_bindings.update: Advance only after the corresponding committed fact or permitted presentation event.
data_bindings.stale: Recompute from the loaded committed snapshot.
data_bindings.error: Keep the prior valid lead and surface the load rejection.
data_bindings.permission: Never expose forbidden fact identifiers or oracle payloads.

data_bindings.source: proposal result returned by the canonical machine
data_bindings.initial_state: No verdict is implied before a proposal.
data_bindings.update: Render committed or held immediately with redundant signals.
data_bindings.stale: The ledger mirrors the latest returned result and never authors canonical truth.
data_bindings.error: Use a neutral hold and a concrete next valid entry.
data_bindings.permission: Hidden labels remain outside player-visible copy.

data_bindings.initial_state: Render unfilled chain at episode start (0/3).
data_bindings.update: Update link fill on every commit that adds a matching fact.
data_bindings.stale: Never stale during episode; regenerated from committed snapshot at save/load.
data_bindings.error: No error state; chain is derived from authoritative facts.
data_bindings.permission: Never expose fact IDs or implementation details; only render link names (LENS, MOUNT, LEAD).

data_bindings.source: contribution_delta(prior_state, next_state) returning facts_added, inventory_added/removed, stage_from, stage_to
data_bindings.initial_state: No contribution shown at episode start (first observation has no prior state).
data_bindings.update: Render CONTRIBUTION after every commit using only labels explicitly allowlisted in FACT_LABEL; never render a raw fact ID.
data_bindings.stale: Preserved in ledger scroll; not regenerated.
data_bindings.error: If no added fact has an allowlisted public label, show generic 'State recorded' instead of an identifier.
data_bindings.permission: Never expose hidden oracle labels or sealed secrets; all text derives from approved FACT_LABEL and gate-to-rule mappings.

data_bindings.source: hold_gate_code mapped to GATE_BY_CODE, then to rule text
data_bindings.initial_state: No rules shown until first hold.
data_bindings.update: Append RULE LEARNED | GATE_NAME: rule_text on first hold on any gate. Append RULE RECALLED (n) | GATE_NAME on subsequent holds on the same gate.
data_bindings.stale: Preserved in ledger scroll; gate name and rule text do not change retroactively.
data_bindings.error: If gate does not match any known rule, render 'The policy held this entry.' as fallback.
data_bindings.permission: Gate names and rule texts come from approved GATE_BY_CODE mapping; never expose oracle-only labels like keeper_betrayal.

data_bindings.source: _contribution_log (list of commits), rules_learned_set (unique gates), and technical_snapshot (state_hash, entry_count, hold_count)
data_bindings.initial_state: Modal rendered with all three sections populated.
data_bindings.update: Static at end-card render time; no live updates.
data_bindings.stale: N/A; rendered once at episode end.
data_bindings.error: If _contribution_log is empty, show 'No entries were committed this session.'; if no gate has held, show 'RULES LEARNED 0 | none'.
data_bindings.permission: INVESTIGATOR'S CONTRIBUTION uses the FACT_LABEL map. RULES LEARNED shows unique gate names (DISCLOSURE/QUEST STAGE, PRECONDITION, etc.). The technical receipt shows only ENTRIES/HOLDS/FINAL STAGE counts, the state-hash prefix, and HOLDS BY GATE; no hidden oracle label, sealed fact, or player-identifying data.

matrix.expected: Primary action, essential controls, focus, and key art hierarchy are readable without Korean or duplicate bilingual copy.

matrix.state: commit, held proposal, and dialogue choices
matrix.expected: The verdict remains distinguishable without motion or color alone and every held proposal names a next valid action.

matrix.state: complete golden path and episode receipt
matrix.input: layout inspection only; touch gameplay is not claimed
matrix.expected: The stacked layout keeps the ending summary, receipt, and essential labels visible without clipping.

matrix.state: committed entry with CONTRIBUTION and CASE CHAIN visible
matrix.expected: CONTRIBUTION clause rendered below COMMITTED line. CASE CHAIN shows filled link. No decorative glyphs, ASCII-only text, all text legible at 1× scale and responsive to 200% scaling.

matrix.state: first hold on a new gate with RULE LEARNED line
matrix.expected: RULE LEARNED | GATE: rule_text rendered below HELD line. Gate name and rule text are ASCII-only, sentence-case. Text wraps or reflows without clipping. No color-only encoding of gate type.

matrix.state: end-card receipt with INVESTIGATOR'S CONTRIBUTION and RULES LEARNED sections
matrix.expected: Three distinct sections: INVESTIGATOR'S CONTRIBUTION (contributions list), RULES LEARNED (sorted gate list), and TECHNICAL RECEIPT (hash, counts). Each section has a title and remains ordered in the end card's one shared receipt region; no independent section scrolling is claimed.

matrix.state: episode save/load cycle: CASE CHAIN re-derived, CONTRIBUTION and RULE lines not persisted
matrix.expected: Load restores only the canonical snapshot (saves carry no presentation data); CASE CHAIN is re-derived from the loaded facts and matches CASE n/3. CONTRIBUTION, UNLOCKED, and RULE lines plus ENTRIES/HOLDS counters are presentation-only and restart with the session; the ledger shows the LOADED integrity line instead of replaying them. State-hash integrity is verified on load.

acceptance: CASE CHAIN line is visible and updates correctly on every commit reflecting LENS, MOUNT, LEAD fill state.
CONTRIBUTION clause appears immediately after every COMMITTED entry with accurate facts_added, inventory_added/removed, and stage progression.
RULE LEARNED or RULE RECALLED line appears after holds with matching gate name and rule text from approved mapping.
End-card two-part receipt renders three distinct sections with no visual or informational overlap.
All presentation surfaces use ASCII-only text, sentence-case, and color-redundant symbols.
No hidden oracle labels (keeper_betrayal, etc.) appear in player-facing text.
Text scales to 200% without losing content or readability.
Reduced motion disables any CONTRIBUTION/RULE/CHAIN animations; static text always readable.
verification.evidence: Record Godot build version, project.godot SHA-256, viewport dimensions, input method, locale, and screenshot/video of ledger scroll and end-card for each matrix row.

decisions.decision: Use an English-only polish pass rather than adding a new localization subsystem.
decisions.basis: The user requested English output and the smallest safe diff preserves the established research and UI owners.

decisions.decision: Keep the evidence-folio layout while reducing duplicated bilingual copy and persistent control clutter.
decisions.basis: The existing art direction is explicit and already bound to public-safe assets; hierarchy, focus, and concise copy are the actual defects.

decisions.decision: Add CONTRIBUTION, RULE LEARNED, and CASE CHAIN presentation surfaces to the ledger and end-card.
decisions.basis: Aside intake report (2026-09-02) identifies legible progress and refusals as essential for perceived competence and rule discovery. Design hypothesis H-CONTRIB-01, H-RULE-02, H-CHAIN-03, H-RECEIPT-04 operationalize these patterns. Decision D-062 assigns responsibility for engineering-side UI contract to design-docs lane.

route_out.next_owner: human presentation study (owner-run playtest, no automated data collection)
route_out.reason: The UI contract is engineering-frozen; player perception of competence, rule discovery, and frustration reduction require qualitative post-episode feedback from actual players. Variant vs. control comparison is design decision gate, not engineering validation gate.
